J1-GAP-unauth-static-get-catalog.note: First exported method is a GET that returns static capability/catalogue data (languages, strategies, report types, schema templates, email provider status) with 200 to an anonymous caller. The mutating methods on the same routes are guarded.

J1-GAP-unauth-db-read-before-auth.note: GET reads the database for an anonymous caller. /api/activity ignores the APISecurityChecker result and runs an unscoped post/audit query (cross-tenant read with a real DB); /api/quotes and /api/quotes/[id] have no auth on GET; /api/platforms/[platform]/metrics uses PUBLIC_READ and answers 200.

J1-GAP-unauth-undocumented-403.note: Anonymous caller gets 403 ('No bearer token provided') instead of 401, and the route source does not document a 403. Denied, but with the wrong status.

J1-GAP-unauth-validates-before-auth.note: Query/path validation runs before authentication, so an anonymous caller gets 400 (and the supported-provider list) instead of 401.

J1-GAP-malformed-json-500.note: request.json() is inside the handler's catch-all, so an unparseable body becomes 500 instead of 400. Scratch check: the same routes answer 400/200/404 (not 500) to a valid '{}' body, so the 500 is the parse failure.

J1-GAP-malformed-json-accepted.note: POST /api/user/api-keys swallows a JSON parse error as {} and creates a key with the default name (200) instead of rejecting the body with 400.
